listing.summary: A cross sector Conglomerate with its main focus on military services, including armed escort, mercenary, weapons trade. Their service are varied, and most faction within the sector have purchased military service from RigSec.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a military-focused faction offering escort, mercenary, and weapons trade services.

description:
Rigel Security

By Shenqiang (Aka. ChenLingShinSou)

Translated by Myco and Miko

Dependencies:
Lazy Lib https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=5444.0
Magic Lib https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=25868.0
Graphic Lib https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=10982.0

Patch 0.23 is now out fixing the rebound bug and several other known issues. Oct 12, 2024 Hotfix for missing phased energy kit description.

Download:

A cross sector Conglomerate with its main focus on military services, including armed escort, mercenary, weapons trade. Their service are varied, and most faction within the sector have purchased military service from RigSec. While backed up by various capital ships, the fleet is mainly based on more economical and flexible cruisers and destroyers.

Currently Adds a faction with
13 Ships
15 Weapons
7 LPC
11 Hullmods
2 Star Systems

aiDescription: Introduces a conglomerate specializing in military services, including armed escort and mercenary work. The faction features a fleet primarily composed of cruisers and destroyers, backed by capital ships. It adds 13 ships, 15 weapons, 7 LPCs, 11 hullmods, and 2 star systems.
